about: The editor's running notebook of ongoing storylines. At most 15 threads.

threads.status: Roadshow began 10 Nov at $70 to $78 a share for 825m shares; pricing expected 18 Nov and first trade 19 Nov.
Day one ended 10 Nov with prisoner swaps and territory discussed; day two on 11 Nov, with US envoys possibly going to Moscow and Kyiv.
Trump says Iran is effectively over; Tehran denies talks and says strikes continue.
Reports of a cut to about 60% for 2030; government says no decision, with a Downing Street meeting due 11 Nov.
Eisenkot has the mandate to form a government but cancelled a meeting with Likud on 11 Nov.
Brazil package carries the 2027 front-wing concept; Stella says more parts arrive in Las Vegas.
Antonelli leads Verstappen by 111 points and Mercedes have the constructors' title; Las Vegas is 22 Nov, then Qatar and Abu Dhabi.

threads.topic: Nvidia board probe of Jensen Huang
threads.status: Independent committee investigating after reports of a foreign intelligence operation; no update since 10 Nov.
Anthropic Mythos 5.2, OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber and Google Gemini 4 Carbon all have restricted cyber variants.
Runs to 20 Nov with logistics problems; Burnham leads a session on 12 Nov.
BMA consultants voted for a 48-hour strike at the end of November; Burnham says there is no money but offers talks.
Brussels summit on 20 Nov on a narrower reset covering food, energy and youth mobility.
